verdict.rationale: GitLab's own materials say it ships first-party SAST and SCA (dependency) scanners, plus Secret Detection and DAST, running "in every pipeline," with findings shown directly in merge requests and IDEs. Trivy is its default container scanning engine. This covers both halves of the story: vulnerable dependencies and code security issues, scanned automatically. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on scanner configuration and supported languages or ecosystems, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the automatic scanning works as described (the evidence is homepage-level marketing).
